$comment: Key prefixes → the screen they belong to. `order` is the drafting order (help last, so its prose sees the labels it refers to). `maxLengthRatio` caps a draft at that multiple of the source length (+10 chars); `referenceNamespaces` are labels the model is shown for consistency.

common.hint: Buttons and words shared by every screen (Cancel, Done, Undo). Short imperatives.

shell.hint: The app frame: bottom navigation destinations and the crash screen.

tabs.hint: The Tabs screen: comics kept open, sorted by recent/added/series.

catalog.hint: The Library (catalog) screen: library toolbar, sort/filter menus, volume cards and their context menus, folder actions, move/delete dialogs, translation dialogs.

reader.hint: The comic reader: page chrome, translate menu, overlay box editor and box list sheet, page jump, filmstrip, review reasons.

sidebar.hint: The desktop reader's translations side panel (region list, per-box editor, full-page translate).

header.hint: The desktop reader's top bar and its menus (reading direction, page turn, overlay toggles).

settings.hint: Settings: Display, Translation (providers, models, on-device), Overlay, Libraries, backup/transfer, search index. Field labels, hints and validation messages.

libraries.hint: Settings → Libraries: library cards, remote server forms, scan/erase actions.

conn.hint: Connection errors and hints when a remote library server cannot be reached.

sync.hint: Progress and outcome messages while indexing a remote library.

scan.hint: Progress messages while scanning local files.

import.hint: Importing comic files: progress, per-file results, failures.

job.hint: Batch (whole-volume) translation jobs: status badges, activity lines, retry/warning messages shown in the Library and Settings.

model.hint: On-device model variant names and descriptions (Hy-MT2 GGUF).

onboarding.hint: The first-run tour: five short pages with a title and one paragraph each.

error.hint: Friendly error messages shown in toasts and status lines.

authors.hint: Author attribution rendered from folder names.

help.hint: The in-app Help guide: long prose paragraphs and list items describing features. Keep control names EXACTLY as their labels in the referenced namespaces, quoted the same way the source quotes them.
